A.policy: CD4 primary with unsupported-gene K562 fallback

B.policy: H1 direct estimates when measured; H1 shared prior plus held-target-calibrated CD4/K562 transfer otherwise

C.policy: H1 direct estimates when measured; H1 shared prior plus held-target-calibrated CD4/K562 transfer otherwise

cd4_selection.prediction_call_proxy: Two-sided normal p-values from predicted log2FC and source SE scaled to 400 cells; within-row eligible-gene BH; not a Wilcoxon or competition score
cd4_selection.selection_objective: Direction-fidelity proxy + Jaccard proxy + 0.5*(1-relative bidirectional log2FC MSE), subject to MSE <=1.02 of zero
cd4_selection.scope: Nested target-held-out within-CD4 donor validation, not anonymous-context or leaderboard validation; enriched donor subsets

h1_selection.scope: Target-held-out, disjoint public H1 batches; 400-cell normal call proxy compared with actual source Wilcoxon calls; not challenge accuracy

cross_lineage_selection.acceptance_policy: Candidate selection obeys 1.02 zero-relative MSE guardrail; held-target procedure must improve composite score, with its MSE tradeoff reported rather than claimed as an improvement
cross_lineage_selection.scope: Source-context transfer into 13 public H1 targets; H1 response for each scored target excluded from all predictions; small, selected target panel and not B/C validation

expression_gates: Multiply by min(1, context gene mean CPM/5) and min(1, context target mean CPM/5); fixed modeling assumption, not fitted biology
simulation: 400 separately guide/depth-stratified original control cells per target/context; binomial thinning and zero-aware depth-scaled Poisson increases
source_limitations: No hidden competition responses or leaderboard accuracy estimate.
Lineage assignments are marker-based hypotheses, not known cell identities.
Shared H1 responses are based on 13 selected public targets, not an unbiased challenge response distribution.
Normal 400-cell call proxies are not challenge Wilcoxon scoring; nested source validation cannot guarantee B/C transfer.
Selection trades modest squared-error degradation for downstream response coverage and direction yield.
No new HCT116/HEK293T response model is fit from underpowered pilot cells.
